_about: Big Ma's room, fitting corner (greybox). Anchors are in each crop's own pixels (assets/cook/characters/<who>-neutral.webp); js/dress/doll.js draws code overlays there until the foundation's overlay-at-anchor sprites land. head: centre x, top of head y, head width w, face ellipse. torso: the box from the shoulders down. place: where the figure stands in the 1600x900 world (bottom centre) and its height.
